She looked up at me, uncertainty in her eyes.

She must have heard the whole thing.

en.html:
Muramasa"...Mido. That man wanted you to kill him, and then kill me also."
Muramasa"Using the oath of the Balance of Good and Evil."
Kageaki"So it seems."
Muramasa"...Even that would have been all right with me..."
Muramasa"I thought, if only I were gone, you could forget about fighting and live."
Kageaki"..."
Muramasa"Are you really going to fight?"
Muramasa"Keep on fighting?"
Muramasa"Is that really all right with you?"
Kageaki"Yes."

en.html:
Kageaki"I will... take command of all fighting power in this world."
Kageaki"Stand at the very top. Then whoever asks, I will lend them my strength."
Kageaki"Whoever wants victory will want my power. But the price, they will have to pay."
Kageaki"The person himself. Someone precious to that person."
Kageaki"What they ought to protect. Their good. Their justice."
Kageaki"That is what I will take in payment for killing their enemy."
Muramasa"..."
Kageaki"The Balance of Good and Evil. This way of fighting, I will spread through the world."
Kageaki"Until everyone knows that this is the truth of conflict, admits it... and comes to loathe it."
Kageaki"Until fighting is gone from the earth."
Muramasa"...Mido..."
Kageaki"Muramasa. What will you do?"
Kageaki"Will you come with me?"
Muramasa"—"
Muramasa"I..."

Tadayasu"The meaning of Yuhi's death."
Tadayasu"I won't ask what that meaning was. Just now... I don't want to hear it."
Tadayasu"Whatever was taken in exchange for Yuhi's life, I don't want to know."
Tadayasu"But you, Didi... value that meaning. Protect it. At least that much."
Tadayasu"That's what you sacrificed Yuhi for."

en.html:
I held out my hand.
She took it.

A firm strength answered mine.

With our hands clasped, I made a vow.

At the very end.

Someday, when our purpose was fulfilled...

We would make our own payment.

What was most precious to us.
Each other.

Sorimachi"...Heh, heh. Going after all, are you...?"
Kanae"Never mind other people. What will you do?"
Sorimachi"Me, I'm going home. That fellow is now... just another badmash. You'll find his sort anywhere."
Sorimachi"No time to keep entertaining him... Back to the gang, back to work. Since the shogunate fell, even earning enough to eat has become such a business."
Kanae"I see. Do apply yourself."
Sorimachi"Heh, heh, hehhh...! Then, if you'll excuse me..."

en.html: A gust of wind passed. Something fierce within it scorched my skin. I turned. A girl I knew well stood there in the dusk, a deep-blue tsurugi at her side. On the face she turned toward me— Anger.◆ Grief.◆ And resolve.
en.text:
A gust of wind passed.

Something fierce within it scorched my skin. I turned.

A girl I knew well stood there in the dusk, a deep-blue tsurugi at her side.

On the face she turned toward me—

Anger.◆
Grief.◆
And resolve.

ja.html: 風が一陣、流れた。 　そこに紛れる猛気が、肌を炙る。 　俺は振り返った。 　良く知る少女が立っている。 　濃藍の劒冑を従えて、夕闇の下。 　今、俺へ向ける顔にあるものは―― 　怒り。◆ 　嘆き。◆ 　そして決意。
ja.text:
風が一陣、流れた。

　そこに紛れる猛気が、肌を炙る。
　俺は振り返った。

　良く知る少女が立っている。
　濃藍の劒冑を従えて、夕闇の下。

　今、俺へ向ける顔にあるものは――

　怒り。◆
　嘆き。◆
　そして決意。

en.html: Not one word between us, and I knew the fight could not be avoided. My mouth twisted bitterly—◆then I caught myself. No. Not like this. This was not the face for a demon going into battle. I was about to throw myself into the very conflict I had asked for. My own wish. Then why was I making a sour face about it? The expression should be like this. Like this—
en.text:
Not one word between us, and I knew the fight could not be avoided.
My mouth twisted bitterly—◆then I caught myself.

No.
Not like this.

This was not the face for a demon going into battle.

I was about to throw myself into the very conflict I had asked for. My own wish. Then why was I making a sour face about it?

The expression should be like this.
Like this—

ja.html: 一語も交わさず、避けられぬ戦いの到来を感じ取り。 　俺の口が苦く歪んで――◆ふと、気付く。 　違う。 　こうでは、ないな。 　戦いに臨む悪鬼の貌かおは、こうではない。 　俺は今から、俺自身が求めた闘争へ身を投じるのだ。 　苦にがる理由が何処にあろうか。 　表情は、こうだ。 　こう――
ja.text:
一語も交わさず、避けられぬ戦いの到来を感じ取り。
　俺の口が苦く歪んで――◆ふと、気付く。

　違う。
　こうでは、ないな。

　戦いに臨む悪鬼の貌かおは、こうではない。

　俺は今から、俺自身が求めた闘争へ身を投じるのだ。
　苦にがる理由が何処にあろうか。

　表情は、こうだ。
　こう――

en.html:

I followed.

Spoke the words of the oath.
Called her name.

Turned my own flesh to steel—
